Name: Dray's Desert Farm
Author: Draylon
Description:
Desert Themed Farm, with a large Mine that spawns ore at about 3-7x the Normal rate depending on your Mining Skill.
Sand is Tillable, so you can plant. Sprinklers are also Allowed.
This map Does rotate with seasons, so you can still plant fall crops in fall, etc.
The Mine also has a pool of water in it that you can relax in like you would the spa

This is a custom farm location, so it does not replace any of the vanilla farms.

The Spouse area is right to the right of the house up against that little cliff there.


I think i got all the kinks worked out, PLEASE LET ME KNOW IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS OR ANYTHING WEIRD SO I CAN FIX IT.
